Back up your icons, move them to another PC, and give brand logos the background you want.

**Download `iconger.exe` below**, or open Iconger: it will offer the update itself.

## New
- **Export and import your setup.** Settings has a new "Back up or move your setup" card. Export saves a `.iconger` file with every custom icon inside it, so it also works on another PC. Import matches each app by its shortcut, then its program, then its name, backs up the originals as usual, and tells you what was applied and what was skipped (and why).
- **Backgrounds for Simple Icons logos.** When you pick a Simple Icons logo, the Adjust panel now has a Background section: a rounded square, a circle, or no background at all, in any colour (the brand colour, a swatch, or your own). With no background the colour goes to the logo itself, so a black logo can now be blue.

## Improved
- Icons from the icon themes are drawn much more faithfully. The old SVG renderer missed shading, gradients and embedded images in many theme icons (Fluent's Steam and Discord icons, for example); Iconger now uses a more complete renderer.

Your backups and settings carry over.
